bedrockify.options.subCategory.bedrockOv: Configure the top left overlay and saving overlay.
bedrockify.options.subCategory.Reach-Aro: Place a block ahead of the block you are standing on. Stand near the edge, look down, and aim into empty space.
bedrockify.options.loadingScreenChunkMap: Enables the Chunk Map Progress widget on loading screens.
bedrockify.options.recipes.tooltip: Adds Bedrock dyeing and crafting rules. Boats and barrels keep the vanilla recipes, and cobwebs cannot be crafted into string, matching Bedrock 1.20.10+. Re-open the world to apply recipe changes.
bedrockify.options.reachAround.distance: Maximum Distance from the Block Border:
Show a BedrockIfy button in game options. The Forge Mods menu and the B key in a world can also open the configuration.
bedrockify.options.pickupAnimations.tool: Enables the Bedrock Item HotBar Animations when picking, using, damaging items and tools.
bedrockify.options.toolbarStyle.tooltip: The item toolbar will be slightly transparent in Bedrock style.
bedrockify.options.bedrockShading.toolti: This includes the feature of Light Block Shading, Sunlight Glare and Sky Color Attenuation.
bedrockify.options.sunlightIntensity.too: The amount of sky color attenuation when looking at the sun. This is ignored when other shader mods are working.
bedrockify.options.fireAspectLight: Use Fire Aspect to light stuff:
bedrockify.options.fireAspectLight.toolt: Right-clicking on blocks like candles and tnt with a tool enchanted with Fire Aspect will light/prime them.
bedrockify.options.mixins.description: Advanced switches for groups of game-code integrations. Change them to isolate mod compatibility issues. Defaults are enabled; restart Minecraft after changing these switches.
bedrockify.options.elytraStop: End Elytra Gliding with the Jump Key:
bedrockify.options.elytraStop.tooltip: After gliding with the jump key released for about half a second, press jump (Space by default) to end gliding. You then fall normally; this does not hover or remove the elytra.
bedrockify.options.bedrockCauldron.toolt: Toggles Bedrock Cauldron functionality, enabling cauldrons to hold tinted water and potions. Disabling this option won't remove cauldrons holding the new special liquids that already exist in the world.
bedrockify.loadingTips.1: Use seagrass to attract and breed turtles.
bedrockify.loadingTips.2: Protect baby turtles from hostile mobs!
bedrockify.loadingTips.3: Baby turtles will drop scutes when they grow - these can be crafted into turtle shells.
bedrockify.loadingTips.4: Use a bed to set your respawn point during the day.
bedrockify.loadingTips.5: Brew some water-breathing potions for underwater exploration!
bedrockify.loadingTips.6: Dolphins can lead you to shipwrecks and underwater ruins, feed them cod and follow their trail!
bedrockify.loadingTips.7: Use shears to carve a pumpkin.
bedrockify.loadingTips.8: Use phantom membranes to repair your elytra.
bedrockify.loadingTips.9: There are 3,587 types of tropical fish!
bedrockify.loadingTips.10: Sea pickles can be smelted into lime green dye.
bedrockify.loadingTips.11: Use hay bales to breed Llamas!
bedrockify.loadingTips.12: Compasses point to the world spawn - craft one to find your way back!
bedrockify.loadingTips.13: Trade with villagers to obtain food, tools and even treasure maps!
bedrockify.loadingTips.14: Did you know you can hold a map in your off-hand?
bedrockify.loadingTips.16: Sneak or wear frost-walker boots to walk safely on magma blocks.
bedrockify.loadingTips.17: You can gather cobwebs using shears.
bedrockify.loadingTips.18: Need diamonds? They get more common as you go deeper.
bedrockify.loadingTips.19: Before you mine diamonds, redstone or gold, make sure you're using an iron, diamond or netherite pickaxe or the ore won't drop.
bedrockify.loadingTips.20: Need coal for torches or fuel? Try smelting wood logs in a furnace to make charcoal!
bedrockify.loadingTips.21: Gold is more abundant in Badlands biomes!
bedrockify.loadingTips.22: Elytra can be used to glide, find them in End City ships!
bedrockify.loadingTips.24: Tridents are dropped by the Drowned, and can be held or thrown.
bedrockify.loadingTips.25: You can breed Hoglins with Crimson Fungus, but it is dangerous!
bedrockify.loadingTips.26: You can smelt 20 items in a furnace by using a block of dried kelp as fuel.
bedrockify.loadingTips.27: Creepers that are killed by skeletons' arrows have a chance of dropping music discs.
bedrockify.loadingTips.30: You can find skins to customise your experience in-game, or on select platforms use your own!
bedrockify.loadingTips.31: Texture packs change the way that blocks, items and even the menus look in game. Try them out!
bedrockify.loadingTips.37: Emerald ores are the rarest ores in Minecraft! They can only be found in mountains and meadows!
bedrockify.loadingTips.38: Taming a skeleton horse doesn't require a saddle.
bedrockify.loadingTips.40: Diorite, you either love it or hate it.
bedrockify.loadingTips.41: Phantoms are dangerous mobs that appear during the night. Make sure to sleep regularly!
bedrockify.loadingTips.42: Zombies turn into Drowned if they sink under water.
bedrockify.loadingTips.43: Minecraft Live takes place every year! Look out for the next one!
bedrockify.loadingTips.44: Using fireworks boosts elytra speed in mid air. Just... make sure they don't explode, otherwise it'll hurt BADLY!
bedrockify.loadingTips.45: Gold is most common in the Nether and Badlands biomes.
bedrockify.loadingTips.50: Riptide enchantment will propel you through the air in the rain.
bedrockify.loadingTips.51: Minecraft Live is a worldwide interactive live-streaming event. Grab your items and join the party!
bedrockify.loadingTips.53: The Beacon is a powerful item that can only be crafted with a nether star from the Wither!
bedrockify.loadingTips.55: Did you know that nether stars can't be destroyed by explosions?
bedrockify.loadingTips.56: When digging straight up, place a torch at your feet to break any sand or gravel that could potentially fall down on you.
bedrockify.loadingTips.58: Shear a Beehive or nest to get Honeycomb, use a Bottle to get honey.
bedrockify.loadingTips.59: Place a Campfire under a Beehive or nest to harvest honey peacefully. Your bees will thank you.
bedrockify.loadingTips.60: Respawning in the Nether requires a charged Respawn Anchor.
bedrockify.loadingTips.61: You can charge a Respawn Anchor with Glowstone.
When off, standing placement is allowed. You must still be grounded near an edge and look down into empty space.
bedrockify.options.legacyRecipes.tooltip: Optional pre-1.20.10 recipes: boats require a wooden shovel, barrels use sticks, and one cobweb crafts into nine string. Requires Bedrock crafting rules. Re-open the world to apply changes.
bedrockify.options.disableFlyingMomentum: Apply additional braking after releasing movement keys in creative flight. Turn off to keep vanilla Java inertia. Does not change elytra gliding.
bedrockify.options.flyingBrakeStrength.t: Additional velocity reduction each tick after releasing a movement key. 0% keeps vanilla inertia; 100% stops immediately. Default: 25%, retaining brief momentum.
bedrockify.options.editionBranding.toolt: Hide JAVA EDITION below the Minecraft logo. The logo and version information remain visible.
bedrockify.options.mixin.client.core.cli: Supports timing for interface and animation features. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
bedrockify.options.mixin.client.core.bed: Adds the BedrockIfy settings button to game options. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
bedrockify.options.mixin.client.features: Chat Interface
Controls chat layout, safe-area offsets, and opacity. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
Third-Person Eating Animation
Controls third-person eating animations. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
3D Fishing Bobber
Controls the Bedrock-style three-dimensional fishing bobber. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
Held Item Information
Controls held-item names and information above the hotbar. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
Idle Hand Animation
Controls first-person idle hand movement. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
World Loading Screens
Controls Bedrock-style world loading screens. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
Hotbar Item Animation
Controls hotbar animations for item use, pickup, and durability changes. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
Forward Bridging Assistance
Controls the placement integration; adjust activation conditions in Gameplay. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
Saving Indicator
Controls the indicator shown while a world saves. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
Interface Safe Area
Controls safe-area offsets for the hotbar, status bars and other interface elements. Restart the game after changing this.
Inventory Slot Highlight
Controls highlighting for the inventory slot under the mouse. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
Sheared Sheep Colors
Controls the colored appearance of sheared sheep. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
Environmental Color Variation
Controls subtle Bedrock-style environmental color variation. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
Larger Dragged Items
Controls enlarged icons while dragging inventory items. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
bedrockify.options.mixin.common.features: Controls the recipe integration; gameplay switches are in Gameplay. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
bedrockify.options.mixin.client.features: Item Use Animation
Controls Bedrock-style item use animations. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
Block Shading
Controls Bedrock-style shading on block surfaces. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
Sun Glare
Controls glare and sky-color attenuation when facing the sun. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
bedrockify.options.mixin.common.features: Controls the integration for igniting blocks with Fire Aspect tools. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
Controls extra bonemeal behavior for plants such as sugar cane. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
Controls food particles when feeding animals. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
Controls cauldron-related integration; the gameplay switch is in Gameplay. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
Controls fern generation when applying bonemeal to grass. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
bedrockify.options.mixin.client.features: Interface Opacity
Controls opacity integrations for the hotbar, chat, and other information. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
Java Edition Subtitle
Allows the interface setting to hide the JAVA EDITION subtitle. Restart Minecraft after changing this switch.
bedrockify.options.creativeInventory.too: Use Construction, Equipment, Items and Nature categories with a classic large grid. Forge tab pages, mod tabs, player inventory and saved hotbars are preserved. Reopen the inventory after disabling to restore the Java UI. Small windows use the compact layout.
bedrockify.options.creativeInventoryGrou: Left-click a + or − group icon to expand or collapse; right-click to take its representative item. Search results stay flat and unrecognised mod items remain visible. Requires the classic creative inventory.
bedrockify.options.mixin.client.features: Classic creative inventory and groups
Hooks creative categories, grid, groups and client picker slots. Disable and restart to restore the original creative screen when using another creative inventory UI mod.
bedrockify.creative.groupHint: Left-click to expand/collapse · Right-click to take the representative
bedrockify.creative.expandAll: Expand all groups in this tab
bedrockify.creative.collapseAll: Collapse all groups in this tab
bedrockify.options.survivalInventory.too: Classic layout and recipe categories, using native slots and crafting operations. Small windows, custom screens and menus with extra slots keep their original layout. Reopen the screen to apply.
Group output items using material tags. Click + to expand; search results stay flat. Every actual recipe is retained.
bedrockify.options.mixin.client.features: Survival inventory & crafting UI
Controls classic inventory, crafting-table and recipe-book hooks. Disable to use the Java interface; requires a restart.
bedrockify.survival.group: %s: %s recipes (left-click to expand; right-click to place the representative recipe)
bedrockify.options.rememberInventoryStat: Restore categories, expanded groups and list position after reopening or restarting. Creative tabs, inventory and crafting table are remembered separately.
bedrockify.options.rememberInventorySear: Restore inventory and recipe searches. When disabled, reopening clears the search and starts at the first page.
bedrockify.options.menuPanorama.tooltip: Use the rotating vanilla title panorama for world selection, loading, options and vanilla settings subpages. Disable to restore original backgrounds; rotation follows the vanilla speed option.
bedrockify.options.slowRegeneration.tool: Disable fast saturation healing and use the configured natural healing interval. The naturalRegeneration game rule still applies.
Time between healing 1 health point (half a heart). Default: 4 seconds. Requires slow natural regeneration.
bedrockify.options.noAttackCooldown.tool: Attacks use full strength without charging. Damage immunity time still applies. Multiplayer uses the server setting.
bedrockify.options.armorStand.tooltip: New stands have arms. Sneak-use cycles 13 poses; changed redstone strength selects a pose. Server controlled.
bedrockify.options.sneakingShield.toolti: Automatically raise a held shield while sneaking and lower it when you stop. Manual item use and shield cooldown take priority.
bedrockify.options.paperDollTimeoutTicks: Paper doll display duration after actions
bedrockify.options.mixin.common.features: Controls pose cycling, default arms and redstone responses. Restart the game after changing this.
bedrockify.options.mixin.client.features: Sneaking shields
Controls automatic shield use and sustained blocking while sneaking. Restart the game after changing this.
bedrockify.options.mixin.common.features: Controls attack cooldown and natural regeneration changes. Restart the game after changing this.
bedrockify.options.waterColors.tooltip: Use Bedrock water surface colors for vanilla biomes. Unmapped biomes keep their original colors.
bedrockify.options.waterFogColor.tooltip: Use the separate Bedrock underwater colors. Requires biome water colors; visibility distance and night vision keep Java behavior.
bedrockify.options.waterColorNoise.toolt: Add the existing subtle color noise over the Bedrock palette. Off by default to retain the imported colors.
bedrockify.options.mixin.client.features: Biome water colors
Controls biome water and underwater color changes. Restart the game after changing this.
bedrockify.options.armorStand.extendedRe: Off: detect power received by the block directly below the stand. On: also detect power at the stand and above it. Highest input wins; changed nonzero power updates the pose, while power off retains it. Server controlled.
bedrockify.options.sharpness.tooltip: Sharpness adds 1.25 damage per level (6.25 at V), without changing base weapon damage. Server controlled and synchronized to client tooltips.
block.bedrockify.light_blue_hardened_gla: Hardened Light Blue Stained Glass Pane
block.bedrockify.light_gray_hardened_gla: Hardened Light Gray Stained Glass Pane
bedrockify.options.projectiles.tooltip: Adjusts ender pearls, player-fired arrows, thrown tridents, and trident Impaling damage. Server controlled.
bedrockify.options.portalSpawning.toolti: Overworld portal ignition and random ticks attempt difficulty-dependent zombified piglin spawning.
bedrockify.options.tridentKiller.tooltip: Pistons and nearby trapdoor or carpet changes can reactivate grounded tridents without Loyalty.
message.bedrockify.nether_reactor.player: All players need to be close to the reactor.
message.bedrockify.nether_reactor.built_: The nether reactor needs to be built lower down.
The nether reactor needs to be built higher up.
message.bedrockify.nether_reactor.overwo: The nether reactor only works in the Overworld.
message.bedrockify.nether_reactor.cannot: You cannot activate the nether reactor in this game mode.

advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.stage_ho: Grow food, raise animals and make a home.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.stage_in: Build machines, transport and useful equipment.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.stage_ex: Discover oceans, ruins and distant places.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.stage_vi: Trade with villagers and defend them.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.stage_co: Take on dangerous enemies and hazards.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.benchmak: Make a crafting table from four planks.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.hot_topi: Build a furnace with eight cobblestone.
Make cake with wheat, sugar, eggs and milk.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.time_to_: Make a wooden pickaxe with sticks and planks.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.pork_cho: Eat a porkchop that you have cooked.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.rabbit_s: Eat rabbit meat after cooking it.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.artifici: Breed a horse with a donkey to produce a mule.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.repopula: Feed wheat to two cows to produce a calf.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.zoologis: Feed bamboo to two pandas to produce a baby.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.one_pick: One Pickle, Two Pickle, Sea Pickle, Four
Put four sea pickles together in one block space.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.its_a_si: Make and place an oak sign.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.pot_plan: Make a flower pot and place it in the world.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.rainbow_: Collect wool in every one of its 16 colors.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.moar_too: Craft one of every tool type.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.stayin_f: Enter lava with Fire Resistance active.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.iron_man: Equip iron armor in every armor slot.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.sleep_wi: Remain underwater for an entire game day.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.overkill: Inflict at least 18 damage points with one attack.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.when_pig: Ride a saddled pig when it takes damage from falling.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.top_of_t: Place scaffolding at the highest building level.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.beam_me_: Move more than 100 blocks using one ender-pearl throw.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.on_a_rai: Ride a minecart at least 500 blocks away in one direction.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.getting_: Punch a tree until a block of wood pops out.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.camoufla: Defeat a mob while wearing its matching head.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.wax_on_w: Wax copper blocks and scrape the wax away from every required copper type.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.do_a_bar: Propel yourself with a Riptide-enchanted trident.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.have_a_s: Remove a sheep's wool with shears.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.master_t: Earn 1,000 emeralds from trades with villagers.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.the_hagg: Earn or spend 30 emeralds in villager trades.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.echoloca: Give a dolphin fish so it guides you to treasure.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.buy_low_: Trade for the best possible price.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.organiza: Rename a shulker box at an anvil.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.libraria: Add bookshelves to improve an enchanting table.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.let_it_g: Freeze deep-ocean water with Frost Walker boots.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.diamonds: Give another player diamonds by dropping them.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.super_so: Fly through a one-block opening with elytra at over 40 metres per second.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.castaway: Eat dried kelp, then eat no other food for three in-game days.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.dry_spel: Dry a wet sponge in a furnace.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.deliciou: Take freshly cooked cod from a furnace, smoker or campfire.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.renewabl: Use charcoal to smelt wood into more charcoal.

advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.sound_th: Ring a village bell after a villager has been hurt.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.taste_of: Poison a witch with a splash potion.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.trampoli: Bounce 30 blocks upward from a slime block.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.tie_dye_: Dye every piece of leather armor in a cauldron.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.where_ha: Pick up a morning gift from your cat.
advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.smelt_ev: Connect three chests to one furnace with three hoppers.

advancements.bedrockify.bedrock.treasure: Buy an explorer map from a cartographer and enter its marked structure.
bedrockify.creative.view.putDown: Put down the held item to switch views
